_meta.dataset: Non-restaurant activities, each tied to a transit-time check against a hotel
_meta.selection_rule: Every activity lists travel mode and whether the <=60 minute door-to-door target was met, measured with Google Maps transit routing.

activities.name: Fountains of Bellagio
activities.exceptions: Free; show schedule is weather-dependent. Confirm on the official Bellagio page.
activities.transit_note: Center Strip; walkable from any center-Strip hotel. Walk, not transit, is the realistic mode.

activities.name: The High Roller Observation Wheel
activities.transit_note: Center Strip, adjacent to Flamingo and Harrah's - walkable for those hotels.

activities.name: The Mob Museum (National Museum of Organized Crime and Law Enforcement)
activities.transit_note: Downtown; reachable on the Deuce. Adds a strong reason to consider a Downtown/Arts District day alongside Esther's Kitchen and SoulBelly BBQ.

activities.name: 18b Arts District (First Friday art walk area)
activities.open_days: First Friday monthly event - date unverified for Feb/Mar 2027
activities.exceptions: Pairs directly with two MICHELIN Bib Gourmand / Recommended venues on S Main St (Esther's Kitchen, SoulBelly BBQ).
activities.transit_note: Deuce + short walk from the Strip.

activities.name: Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area
activities.exceptions: Timed-entry reservation system has applied seasonally - MUST check the BLM page before travelling.
activities.transit_note: NOT within the 60-minute transit rule by bus. Car or tour required. Flagged as outside the user's constraint unless transport changes.

activities.name: Hoover Dam
activities.transit_note: Well outside the 60-minute rule. Listed for completeness and explicitly flagged.

activities.name: Sphere Las Vegas
activities.location: East of the Strip, behind The Venetian
activities.exceptions: Programming changes; check the official calendar.
activities.transit_note: Walkable from Venetian/Palazzo/Wynn; short transit from center Strip.
